context.narrative_job: Acknowledge the on-success deal fairly, then expose the unpaid role three years out and name it: the vacancy.
context.viewer_before: Every adviser is paid by the transaction.
context.viewer_after: The viewer sees the empty seat that nobody is paid to fill.

data.choice: C: the room fades nearly out; 'A phrase you will hear' and the quote 'We only get paid when you do.' on its words. D: room returns; on 'not one person in that room' advisers and pay lines recede; an empty dashed chair appears across the owner's table on 'sit down with her'; a 'Three years out' marker that no line reaches on 'three years out'; the chair turns oxide on 'no owner'; heading 'The vacancy' on its word.
data.reason: The quote is a common line, not a named firm's statement; the vacancy is a missing role, so it reads as negative space in the accepted room model.

alternatives.choice: Presenter for 'And that is the vacancy'
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Negative space in the model carries it without cost; S11 already has no presenter.
The script calls the deal genuinely good; crossing out implies it is false.

reuse.applies_when: An argument names an unfilled role inside an established structure.
reuse.avoid_when: The role exists but is poorly performed.

nuance.false_inference: That on-success pay is wrong, or that any adviser behaves improperly.
nuance.source_basis: Plan approved to proceed under 'lock it and move on'.

data.method: Strict check; contact sheets and fixes (heading overlap, quote legibility, chair size, near-blank quote entry); render; S11 context from the locked S10 presenter; audio 0.99984 at zero lag; no uniform frames.
data.scope: S11 parts C-D (573 frames) and full S11 context (1936 frames).
